theme: An open Saturday to clear the board.
greeting: Clear calendar today, Dan — no meetings, and the girls are in the house. A quiet Saturday in St. Pete to knock down a few overdue board items before tomorrow's Sunday review with Mike.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike at 9
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute board sweep opens on the Mike + Dan board — a glance today at what's active and what has slipped means you arrive with the agenda already in hand.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: Flagged on the board as the item most likely to bite — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, overdue since Sep 14. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out, so a refundable hold now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: Three term-life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Due yesterday on the board — the shopping half is yours (quotes, term length, coverage). It still needs a target coverage amount and term before the numbers can be run.

flagged.title: Venmo request from the lawn crew
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver is asking $50 for the Sep 17 mowing — an open request still sitting unread in the inbox.

flagged.title: AbeBooks sign-in alert
flagged.detail: A sign-in flagged from an iPhone near Florida on Sep 24 — the same moment as your own book order, so almost certainly you, but worth a glance.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and receipts — Hadestown tickets, a Disney confirmation, an AbeBooks order, and the daily Japanese lesson.

resolved.title: You're moderating a panel at ICGN Toronto
resolved.detail: Elizabeth Thomas confirmed your yes and will send speaker logistics plus a pre-conference call — nothing owed from you now.

recipe.title: Chicken, Sherry, Almond Pot Roast
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in.

acts.line: A clear calendar to open the weekend — nothing scheduled today.
Open hours to make a real dent in the board before it resets tomorrow.
With the girls in the house, a good evening to cook something slow and wind down.
